board.pin_effort_unsupported: {{.V0}}: agent {{.V1}} takes no reasoning effort; remove the field

board.pin_unknown_agent: {{.V0}}: {{.V1}} is not a loaded execution agent definition

launch.pin_owner_conflict: {{.V0}} pins {{.V1}} but the card runs {{.V2}}; take over with --agent {{.V1}} or change the card through a contract decision
review.pin_agent_conflict: {{.V0}} pins {{.V1}} but the command names reviewer {{.V2}}

review.pin_env_conflict: {{.V0}} pins {{.V1}} but the environment override asks for {{.V2}}
